name: Projection-Based Ray Casting for Curvilinear Grids
aliases: Curvilinear Grid Ray Casting (Hong and Kaufman)
Projection-Based Ray Casting for Curvilinear Grids (Hong and Kaufman)
definition: A projection-based ray-casting algorithm for curvilinear grids (hexahedra) that finds the first face by scan-converting boundary faces, then projects all faces to find exit points.
summary: Projection-Based Ray Casting for Curvilinear Grids is a direct volume rendering technique that determines cell traversal by projecting cell faces onto the 2D image plane, avoiding complex 3D geometric intersection tests.
